title: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
summary: Toei's 2015 theatrical feature (93 min; premiered 2015-04-18 — Toei Animation's own lineup entry prints 「2015年4月18日（土）全国公開」, Kanzenshuu's movie guide 'Premiered: 18 April 2015 · Running Time: 93 Minutes'). Measured against THIS owner's instrument — Toriyama's Dragon Ball manga, ch 1-519, finished in 1995 — it is an ORIGINAL: no page of that manga is animated in it, and every placement source puts the story INSIDE a gap between two chapters rather than on them. The wiki's RoF page: 'The film takes place six to ten months after the events of Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods, in June of Age 779, since just after Pan is born … the events are stated to be set five years before the 28th World Martial Arts Tournament, in Age 784. Serving as a sequel to Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods, it is placed between the chapters 517 and 518 of the manga.' That is the same ten-year gap Toei named for Battle of Gods in its 2012-07-17 release — 「原作517話で魔人ブウとの戦いが終わった後、518話までの空白の10年」 — and ch 518 is the Age-784 tournament our rows 289-291 animate. Zero source pages in it → filler (T27), no chapters (A1). TORIYAMA'S CREDIT IS A CREDIT ON THIS SHELF (T26): Toei Animation credits him 原作・脚本・キャラクターデザイン (his first sole screenplay; ja-WP 「本作では初めて単独で脚本も務める」), but his manga closed in 1995 and never took the film's events in, so there is nothing here to adopt — the adopted{author} Sean ruled on 2026-09-05 sits on DRAGON BALL SUPER's episode rows 18-21 / 23-27, that owner's rows, not this manga. THE COMICALIZATION TRAP: Toyotarou drew a three-chapter manga OF the film in V-Jump 2015年4月号-6月号 (ja-WP; Kanzenshuu; the wiki's 'Resurrection F (manga)' page) — an adaptation of the film, in no chapter space of this instrument. POSITION IS THE DECISION HERE: the stored 291.51 is the air-date derivation (2015 against a 1996 finale); the story sits where Sean put Battle of Gods today, after ep 288 and before ep 289 — and three works now share that slot in one order: Yo! Son Goku (Age 776) → Battle of Gods (778) → Resurrection 'F' (779).

position.why: CORRECTED 291.51 → 288.52. THE SLOT: the film is in the ten-year gap between ch 517 and 518 (the wiki's RoF page: 'placed between the chapters 517 and 518 of the manga', Age 779, 'five years before the 28th World Martial Arts Tournament'; Toei's own BoG release for the gap itself: 「原作517話で魔人ブウとの戦いが終わった後、518話までの空白の10年」; ja-WP 神と神 names the same gap in THIS run's numbering, 『ドラゴンボールZ』の第288話と第289話…の間). In our rows, joined by title + date on en-WP's Dragon Ball Z season 9 (R20, never by index): ep 288 遅いぜ悟空！みんなでパーティ!! / 'He's Always Late' 1996-01-10 (filler, no anchor) and ep 289 悟空おじいちゃん！私がパンよ!! / 'Granddaughter Pan' 1996-01-17 (→ ch 517-518, the ten-years-later Budokai). So the film goes after 288, before 289 — the slot Sean ruled for Battle of Gods (288.5). THE SEAT: inside that slot the order is Yo! Son Goku (Age 776; the wiki's BoG page states the precedence outright) → BoG (778) → RoF (779), which is also release order (2008 → 2013 → 2015) — the two orders AGREE, so RoF takes the third seat, 288.52. COST: this re-rules BoG 288.5 → 288.51 (flag 1). If Sean keeps BoG at 288.5, RoF is 288.51 and Yo! Son Goku takes 288.52, out of order in both story and release terms.

flags_for_sean: FLAG 1 — THE 288.5x CLUSTER IS THE RULING, AND IT IS ONE DECISION FOR THREE ROWS. The ten-year gap at ch 517/518 now holds three works, and STORY ORDER AND RELEASE ORDER AGREE on their order (there is no fork between them here): Yo! Son Goku (Age 776; 2008-09-21) → Battle of Gods (Age 778; 2013-03-30) → Resurrection 'F' (Age 779; 2015-04-18). OPTION A (delivered, both orders right): Yo! 288.5 · BoG 288.51 · RoF 288.52 — cost: it RE-RULES Battle of Gods' 288.5, which you ruled today (2026-09-06, related-works.ts). OPTION B (leave BoG alone): BoG 288.5 · RoF 288.51 · Yo! 288.52 — cost: the earliest work in the cluster displays last, wrong in story AND release order; E13's cluster-order audit skips ruled rows, so nothing would flag it. OPTION C (both orders right, no re-ruling): Yo! 288.05 · BoG 288.5 · RoF 288.51 — a sub-.5 seat, precedented once (slime 106509 @24.05, ruled to sit before the wiki row @24.1) but off the N.5 convention every other shelf uses. My recommendation is A; the whole cost is one number on a row ruled hours ago.

FLAG 2 — MECHANICS OF THE MOVE (planRuledMoves). Under Option A both BoG and this row must be ruled in the SAME apply: a mover may take a slot another mover is leaving, but a ruled slot held by a NON-moving row is REFUSED (the mover keeps its stored position and the census lists stored ≠ ruled — the kinnikuman 3276 lesson). Under Options B and C nothing is contested: 288.51 / 288.52 / 288.05 are all free today, and this move EMPTIES 291.51 rather than filling a held slot. 288.5 is currently held by BoG; 291.5 is already empty (BoG left it in wave 5).

FLAG 3 — 正史 IS NOT A STANDING (the wave-5 clause, unchanged). Toei sells the modern films as official history and the licensor's own lineup copy calls this one 「劇場版19作目にして初めて自ら脚本まで手掛けた原作者・鳥山明」's story; under T25/T27 the row is still filler because no page of ch 1-519 is animated in it. One clause in the ledger note keeps a reader from being surprised: 'official continuity, but no chapter of the manga is in it — it happens inside the ten-year gap at ch 517/518, a year after Battle of Gods.'

FLAG 4 — NO ADOPTION ON THIS SHELF, AND THE ADOPTION THAT EXISTS IS ANOTHER OWNER'S. Sean ruled adopted{author} for Resurrection 'F' on 2026-09-05 (T26 sitting, G2) — on DRAGON BALL SUPER's rows 18-21 / 23-27, where the anime restages the film (standing-annotations.ts). Nothing of the film entered THIS instrument: Toriyama's manga finished in 1995, 24 chapters and twenty years before the film. So `adopted` is null here, and the ledger note should say why in one clause rather than leave a curator to wonder why the same film carries an adoption on another shelf.

FLAG 5 — THE COMICALIZATION TRAP, THE SAME SHAPE AS THE YO! SON GOKU ROW. Toyotarou's three-chapter 『ドラゴンボールZ 復活の「F」』 manga (V-Jump 2015年4月号-6月号; ja-WP: 「公開に先立ち…本作を漫画化した読切漫画が3号連続で掲載され…フリーザがゴールデンフリーザに変身する直前までが描かれた」) is an adaptation OF the film, published before it as promotion, in nobody's mainline chapter space — never an instrument, never a chapter to cite, and specifically NOT part of the Dragon Ball Super manga's numbering (that runs ch 1 from 2015-06-20).

FLAG 6 — RULE THIS WITH THE KAI ROW AND THE YO! ROW. dragon-ball-z-kai's Resurrection 'F' verdict proposes 165.51 (behind BoG's ruled 165.5) — the identical story point in Kai's international numbering; the Yo! Son Goku verdict (dragon-ball-z__5152.json) proposes 288.5 and carries the same cluster flag. Three files, one sitting.

FLAG 7 — CURATION SHAPE: position.why and summary are over the 400 / 900 ledger caps; write the note by hand, leading with the conclusion ('official continuity, no chapter of the manga in it: the ch 517/518 gap, a year after Battle of Gods — after ep 288, before ep 289, third of three works in that slot').
